name: a6fdvd-u1-verification-chip
goal: U1 verification chip: a missing verification is a muted outlined 'Not verified' chip with no icon; red with a cross only for a failed verification; green check for passed. Applies to the catalog card and entity header. Source: packages/reports/src/components/shared-primitives/status/Status.svelte. Test: a card with no verification shows the text 'Not verified' and no element painted in the danger colour.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The verification chip needs to show a muted Not verified label when no verification exists. The error color is reserved for failures.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The old shell fixture did not check the unrecorded chip at phone, tablet and laptop sizes. The committed verification-chip spec checks its label, icon, border, and colors at those sizes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The Chromium replay of the committed verification-chip spec at af093edbb9 failed at all three sizes on the Not verified text assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The existing U1 fix cc79d4cd0c renders the unrecorded status as a muted chip.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged Chromium test at cc79d4cd0c passed at all three sizes.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
